en: A colorized panoramic view of a mountain town with many villas and hotels scattered across rolling green hills and forests. In the foreground stands a large multi‑story building with red roofs, while more houses and lodgings extend into the valley and up the slopes. Soft, rounded mountains rise in the background. At the top of the image, German text identifies the place as Ober‑Krummhübel in the Riesengebirge, with an additional label pointing to a specific peak.
